What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

Help Write Our Next Chapter

As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

What Makes You Shine:

You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

We would love to hear from you if you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Crafting What’s Next, Together

You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

The Impact You Will Make

Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Let’s Craft the Incredible

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

Join a fast-growing international MedTech company and take a central role in turning AI ambitions into practical, adopted solutions across the organisation.

Turn AI ambitions into practical business impact

Contura International has been named a Gazelle company two years in a row and has experienced significant growth over the past five years, increasing revenue fivefold and its number of employees tenfold.

As AI Lead, you will join Contura's IT & Projects organisation and report to the Head of IT.

In this newly established role, you will take ownership of the AI roadmap and use-case portfolio and help move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

Working across business and IT, you will drive adoption, build internal AI capability and ensure that initiatives create business value while meeting relevant quality and compliance requirements.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own and drive Contura's AI roadmap, use-case portfolio and implementation plan.

• Translate business needs into qualified use cases, requirements and solution proposals.

• Take successful AI and digital solutions from pilot into controlled production.

• Build internal AI capability through training, workshops and an AI community of champions and key users.

• Coordinate external specialists and contribute to pragmatic AI governance together with IT, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.

Business-minded AI profile with strong implementation skills

We are open regarding your professional background and previous job title. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, turn them into relevant AI or digital solutions and create momentum from idea through implementation and adoption.

We imagine that you bring:

• Experience taking AI or digital solutions from pilot to production and driving user adoption.

• Experience translating business needs into solution proposals, requirements and priorities.

• Practical understanding of data foundations, data quality and integrations.

• Experience with AI and data solutions, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make AI understandable and relevant across the business.

You are pragmatic, curious and delivery-oriented and comfortable creating structure and direction in an area that is still developing. You work well across functions and combine a strategic perspective with practical execution and a clear focus on business outcomes.

Turn AI into lasting business capability

This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Contura develops and applies AI as the company continues its growth and digitalisation journey.

The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Fares Almas at fa@venaris.dk. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV.

Contura International

Contura is a fast-growing international MedTech company that develops, manufactures and commercialises innovative hydrogel-based products for treatment in areas including female urinary incontinence, orthopaedics and veterinary applications. The company has more than 20 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of therapeutic hydrogels and has experienced significant growth in recent years. Learn more about Contura at http://www.contura.dk/

DEA KUDIBAL is looking for an experienced Production Manager to lead our production, sourcing and supply chain. You will play a central role in bringing our collections to life, balancing the quality and craftsmanship our brand is known for with commercial targets and reliable delivery.

You will work closely with our Design, Operations and Finance teams and lead a team consisting of a Purchasing Assistant and a Logistics Manager.

THE ROLE

• Own the production process from sampling and product development through to final delivery

• Lead sourcing and develop our international supplier base, building strong and lasting partnerships.

• Partner with Design on materials, construction, quality and production feasibility

• Negotiate prices, terms and production conditions to achieve target margins while maintaining our quality standards.

• Manage production plans and follow up closely with suppliers to keep collections on schedule.

• Oversee the supply chain from supplier through to delivery, working closely with the Logistics Manager on timelines, risks and handovers.

• Identify opportunities to improve quality, costs and production processes.

• Lead, support and develop the Purchasing Assistant and Logistics Manager.

ABOUT YOU

• You have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in fashion production and sourcing, ideally within a premium brand.

• You have strong experience in international supplier management, production planning and price negotiations.

• You combine a strong eye for quality with a commercial understanding of costs, margins and deadlines.

• You are structured and confident managing multiple collections, suppliers and timelines simultaneously.

• You take ownership, solve problems proactively and communicate clearly with suppliers and internal teams.

• You are a strong people manager who enjoys leading and developing a small team.

• You understand how production, sourcing and logistics work together across the supply chain. Previous logistics experience is a strong advantage, although you will not manage day-to-day logistics.

• You are highly proficient in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and Excel, with strong general Microsoft Office skills.

**

WHAT WE OFFER**

You’ll join a close, collaborative and hands-on team at our Copenhagen HQ in Østerbro, where ideas are shared across departments and decisions move quickly.

We offer a high degree of flexibility, real responsibility and the freedom to shape your role and make an impact. We value a strong team culture, with both planned and spontaneous social activities throughout the year.

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of production, sourcing and supply chain and play an important role in DEA KUDIBAL’s continued growth. Interviews are conducted on a rolling basis. Please send your application and CV to dea@deakudibal.dk.

ABOUT DEA KUDIBAL

DEA KUDIBAL is a Copenhagen-based premium fashion brand known for distinctive hand-drawn prints, vibrant colours and our signature stretch silk. With a strong international presence and continued growth, we combine creativity and craftsmanship with a commercial mindset.

Our headquarters are located in Østerbro, Copenhagen, where we work closely across departments in an informal and collaborative environment. We value initiative, flexibility and individual responsibility, while preserving a culture where people work together, share ideas and enjoy being part of the team.

Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you have a strong creative vision, exceptional sketching abilities, and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials, and the jewellery design process? Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

Your Role

Design & Collection Development

• 
Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• 
Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• 
Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• 
Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• 
Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

• 
Review and provide comprehensive feedback on CADs within agreed timeframes.

• 
Develop creative mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches, and technical drawings to support product development.

• 
Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• 
Review early prototypes and provide feedback ahead of formal prototype review sessions.

• 
Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

• 
Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

• 
Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• 
Ensure legal documentation and inspiration references are provided within agreed timelines.

• 
Maintain accurate design documentation, presentations, folders, and project records throughout the design process.

• 
Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects of their work.

Research & Innovation

• 
Conduct research projects based on briefs from Creative Leadership.

• 
Participate in research trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials, and creative inspiration.

• 
Translate research findings into strong creative concepts and collection ideas.

• 
Contribute to the development of new concepts, innovation opportunities, and future category directions.

• 
Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

• 
Update design presentations with relevant concepts, sketches, and final designs throughout project development.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

Requirements

• 
Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• 
Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• 
Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• 
Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• 
Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• 
Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• 
Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**_Help customers turn technology into solutions they use every day.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

**You’ll work across platform configuration, software development, integrations, and data engineering. Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. There’s room to apply your strengths while building experience in new areas.

**Customer projects with tangible outcomes

**Your work will help construction companies connect their systems, improve their data, and adopt new ways of working. You’ll see solutions through to practical use and understand how your contribution helps customers get more value from Trackunit.

**Collaboration across disciplines

**You’ll work closely with Solution Delivery colleagues, Sales Engineering, IoT Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You’ll have opportunities to learn from different specialisms, share your knowledge, and contribute customer insights that help improve our platforms.

**Ownership and professional growth

**You’ll take responsibility for meaningful parts of customer delivery, with scope reflecting your experience and strengths. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop your customer-facing skills, or take on more complex implementations, you’ll have opportunities to grow through practical work, coaching, and feedback.

**The Opportunity To Shape How We Deliver

**Beyond individual projects, you’ll help develop reusable solutions, implementation patterns, and documentation. Your ideas and experience will contribute to making future deliveries more effective across the global Solution Delivery team.

**An international and flexible workplace

**You’ll join a global team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal development, with a flexible working setup and connections across teams and borders.

****What you’ll work on

******Solution implementation and adoption

**Configure, extend, test, and deploy Manager and IrisX solutions to fit customer workflows and help customers put them into use.

**Integrations and data pipelines

**Connect Trackunit with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, and fleet management tools through APIs, webhooks, and data flows, supporting reliable and secure data exchange.

**Applied data and analytics

**Turn connected construction data into useful insights, supporting use cases such as equipment fault analysis, benchmarking, and emissions reporting, and other customer-specific analytics use cases.

**Customer enablement

**Work with customer teams through technical workshops, training, and implementation support, helping them confidently operate and adopt the solutions delivered.

**Coordinated delivery and continuous improvement

**Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders on implementation activities and clear handovers. Share delivery learnings and customer feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and future deployments.

**Bring your curiosity and perspective

**There are different paths into Solution Delivery. Your experience might come from software engineering, data, integrations, technical consulting, or practical projects that you’re ready to build on.

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We’re interested in how you approach problems, collaborate with others, and connect technical work with customer needs.

If you enjoy building solutions and helping people put them to work, we’d love to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

**Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Virtual second interview / in-person with the hiring manager and the team.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Ambu is redefining the future of endoscopy with a bold vision to become the global leader in the field. Driven by innovation, we are committed to delivering breakthrough solutions that set new standards for patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency.

We invite you to be part of our journey as we accelerate the development of our next-generation urology portfolio—one of Ambu’s fastest-growing and most dynamic business areas. If you are passionate about shaping impactful, innovative solutions in a rapidly expanding market, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the future of urology care.

**Join us in shaping the next generation of Urology solutions

**As our new Global Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving upstream pipeline development project within the urology business area. You will set the commercial direction for new product, ensuring that user and customer needs are central to every stage of development.Success in this role means working closely with R&D, Clinical, Medical Affairs and Sustainability to create strong value propositions and go-to-market strategies that turn innovation into real impact. You’ll join a collaborative team that values creativity and excellence, reporting to the Vice President of Urology Business Area in Global Marketing

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Act as the commercial lead in new product development projects, setting the strategic direction of your product area to ensure a successful launch.

• Translate customer insights and unmet needs into actionable product and design requirements.

• Lead and facilitate advisory boards and engage with key opinion leaders (KOLs) during development.

• Develop business cases and portfolio scenarios to support strategic decision-making.

• Conduct early-phase market and customer investigations to identify opportunities, user needs, and market potential.

• Drive Launch Excellence by defining clear value propositions, product claims, and messaging frameworks.

• Post-launch, continue to optimize performance through customer feedback, data insights, and lifecycle management

**Suggested Candidate Profile

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• Strong commercial, product management, or clinical experience within MedTech or healthcare.

• Experience from Endoscopy is a prerequisite, additional experience in Urology is a strong advantage

• A track record of leading product innovation projects from concept to launch.

• You have participated in or led innovation projects from early concept to launch, enabling you to balance customer insights, technical considerations, and business priorities.

• Ability to turn complex user needs into clear commercial recommendations, using your strategic mindset and business acumen to drive informed decisions across a global matrix organization

• A master’s degree in healthcare, business, marketing, or a related field.

• Strategic thinking, strong analytical skills, and curiosity about clinical and market trends.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to align stakeholders in a matrix environment.

• Excellent English communication skills and a global outlook.

• Willingness to travel up to 20% to conferences, customer visits, and global subsidiaries.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply.

Your application will be treated confidentially.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• 
You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• 
You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• 
You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• 
You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• 
Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• 
Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• 
Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• 
Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• 
Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• 
Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• 
You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• 
You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• 
You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• 
You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• 
You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• 
You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• 
Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• 
Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• 
Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• 
Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• 
You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• 
You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• 
You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• 
You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• 
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• 
For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• 
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• 
Our working language is English.

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance.

• 
Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?
Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.
We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Department: Service Delivery

Location: Vodskov, DK

**Description

**Overview of the Role:

At Veovo, we help airports, transport hubs and major venues understand how people move through their environments, enabling smarter operational decisions and better passenger experiences.

As a Solution Lead, you'll be the crucial link between our customers, project managers and implementation teams. You'll work with customers to understand their operational challenges, translate their requirements into scalable solutions, and ensure successful delivery of Veovo's passenger predictability and flow management technology.

This is a highly visible and varied role that combines customer engagement, data-driven problem solving, technical consultancy and project delivery. You'll help organisations optimise passenger flow, predict congestion, improve queue performance and make better use of real-time operational data.

No two days are the same. One day you may be running a customer workshop, the next reviewing passenger-flow data, advising on sensor placement, or helping an implementation team solve a complex operational challenge.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Act as the primary technical partner to Project Managers, helping define scope, identify risks, and ensure successful delivery of customer projects.

• Lead discovery workshops and work closely with customers to understand operational requirements, passenger flow challenges and business objectives.

• Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements and implementation plans for delivery teams.

• Design and validate passenger flow and data collection solutions that deliver measurable operational value.

• Collaborate with implementation consultants, data specialists and project teams to ensure solutions are deployed successfully and meet customer expectations.

• Serve as the key technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle for both customers and internal stakeholders.

• Support the design of data-driven solutions using operational, passenger and queueing datasets.

• Advise on hardware deployments, including camera and LiDAR placement, to ensure effective coverage and data collection.

• Promote best practices, documentation standards and knowledge sharing across the wider delivery organisation.

• Conduct solution reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of Veovo's implementation methodology.

**What We’re Looking For:

**

When our SaaS solutions fall short, you will find ways to deliver functionality in collaboration with our Automation, Integration, AI and Analytics teams.

Together with the IT product team, you will ensure that the solutions, including the documentation packages we deliver, are GxP compliant and sustainable.

You will report to Simon Rønne Kümmel, Clinical Domain Lead, and Jakob Thrane, People Leader. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

What we offer

jobs.occupation: IoT Services Manager, Nordics, UK & Benelux
jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge

**Benefits

****Practical stuff 📋

**

• Salary: band between 50-60k / month for a senior engineer

• ESOP: every full-time Responsibly'er owns a piece of the company. We'll show you the actual numbers, strike price, vesting, and what your slice could be worth at a few exit scenarios, before you have to decide anything

• Location: Copenhagen. You'll need to be here or firmly planning to move, and to have the right to work in Denmark. English is our working language

• Office: Islands Brygge, right on the water. Great lunch, great coffee, obligatory ping-pong table. Roughly three days a week together, flexible on which and on hours

**Also 🤩

**

• Enthusiastic, highly talented teammates from all backgrounds, always ready to share knowledge, support, and a beer

• Strong personal and professional development in a high-growth environment

• Annual company events and Friday bars

• Real impact. Life is about more than work

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Engineer, Digital Assets

Danske Bank's Digital Assets team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C#/.NET experience. You will build dependable backend services, connect systems and contribute to our technical decisions and engineering practices.

The role

Your work will include designing and developing an orchestration layer linking core banking systems with custody, wallet and blockchain services. Secure APIs, messaging, data handling and reliable transaction processing will be central to the role.

Working closely with the Technical Lead and Product Owner, you will take solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will also collaborate with specialists in architecture, security and operations across the bank.

What you bring

• Proven C# and modern .NET skills, demonstrated through backend software you have delivered and supported in production.

• Good API design and integration skills, covering REST, service authentication and asynchronous communication.

• Experience with relational data modelling and SQL, including transaction handling and query performance.

• Practical knowledge of automated testing, containers, CI/CD and diagnosing services in production.

• The judgement to turn incomplete requirements into testable delivery steps, explain trade-offs, seek feedback and take ownership of your work.

• Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

We encourage continuous learning and thoughtful use of development tools, including AI, alongside sound review and testing habits.

Your day-to-day work

• Develop and maintain C#/.NET backend services with clear interfaces and maintainable code.

• Build the orchestration services connecting core banking systems to external digital-asset platforms.

• Design relational data models and use SQL for consistent, efficient data handling.

• Implement integrations through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks and messaging, using authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and mutual TLS.

• Build idempotent transaction workflows with clear status tracking, retry behaviour and operational exception handling.

• Work with security specialists to integrate established signing and key-management services, applying least privilege, separation of duties and secure credential handling. Ensure signing operations remain auditable.

• Write unit and integration tests and contribute to peer reviews.

• Help automate builds and releases through CI/CD and containerised deployment.

• Instrument services with logs, metrics and alerts, investigate issues and improve reliability and performance.

• Document design decisions, share knowledge and support colleagues through mentoring.

Useful additional experience

Previous blockchain experience is not required. Any of the following would be an advantage:

• Cloud and delivery: infrastructure as code, container platforms, performance testing, monitoring or recovery planning.

• Wallet and custody connectivity: working with provider APIs, SDKs and webhooks for wallet provisioning, transaction submission and status updates.

• Signing and key protection: hardware security modules (HSMs), multi-party computation (MPC), PKCS#11, key derivation using BIP32 or SLIP-0010, or controls for key lifecycle management, backup and recovery.

• Blockchain transactions: Ethereum or other EVM-compatible networks, ERC-20 transfers, gas and nonce handling, finality or chain reorganisations.

• Banking and payment systems: core-banking integration, SEPA Instant or financial messaging based on ISO 20022.

• Regulated software delivery: familiarity with AML/KYC, the Travel Rule, on-chain screening, MiCA or DORA.

Why join the team

• Influence over solution design, technical choices and engineering practices.

• Hands-on development alongside our Technical Lead, Product Owner and colleagues across the bank.

• The opportunity to deepen your knowledge of digital assets within an established financial institution.

• Scope to share your expertise, mentor others and improve how the team builds, tests and runs software.

Workplace and application

Location: Denmark

Workplace: Hybrid setup, 3 days a week in office.

Relocation: No relocation or visa sponsorship offered

Sounds interesting?

Please submit your motivated application and your CV as soon as possible.

Application deadline is November 11th. Interviews will be helt through-out November

If you have any questions, please reach out to Søren Ørding Olsen sreo@danskebank.dk or Philip Nedergaard Hjulskov phhj@danskebank.dk
